note: Everything the leveling planner needs that nanoka does not publish. `expected_per_run` is taken ONLY from fractional counts in the reward previews -- a whole number there is a fixed reward, not an expected drop. Coverage is partial by design: a material with no entry here is priced from app/data/planner/curated_rates.json or reported as resin-unknown, never guessed. See docs/RESEARCH_leveling_planner_data.md sections 9-10.
